Full-stack backend engineer focused on building reliable, scalable microservices and cloud-native systems. Strong emphasis on writing idiomatic Go services, designing gRPC APIs, and operating workloads on Kubernetes. Currently available after 90 days notice period.

- Containerized applications with Docker and deployed to k8s, establishing best practices and runbooks in Confluence for on-call engineers; improved mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 25%.
